subject: Renewal: capacity uplift + term amendment — redline coordination
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam@brightline.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightLine Procurement <procurement@brightline.ai>, Priya Rao <pri.legal@brightline.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal + capacity bump for 2027 — initial ask

Hi Hannah,

Hope you’re doing well. We’ve completed our internal Q4 planning and BrightLine is planning to increase monthly committed tokens by ~2.5x starting Jan 1, 2027. We also want to move from a 12‑month to an 18‑month term to align with our budgeting cycle.

Attached is a markup from our side (OrderForm_Q4_v3.xlsx) and a short note from legal requesting:
- MSA term extension to 18 months (effective 2027‑01‑01)
- Updated SLAs for dedicated capacity windows during our monthly batch runs
- Minor indemnity clarification around third‑party model components

Can your team share proposed redlines and confirm high-level timeline for execution? We’d like to have paperwork signed by mid‑December to hit provisioning deadlines.

Thanks — Sam
Sam Patel
Head of Infrastructure, BrightLine AI
Attachment: OrderForm_Q4_v3.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam@brightline.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity bump for 2027 — initial ask

Sam —

Appreciate the heads up and the file. We can accommodate the capacity uplift and the 18‑month term; I’ve looped in Marissa (legal) and Ben (ops) to scope impacts. High level next steps I propose:

1) Redwood legal issues tracked redline back by EOD Dec 1.
2) Ops to confirm the dedicated capacity window constraints and a provisioning ETA by Dec 6.
3) Commercial to confirm pricing mechanics for the 2.5x committed tokens (Ben will send an example run rate).

If that timing works for BrightLine, we’ll aim to deliver a consolidated redline + comment set so your legal can review before we iterate.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Renewals — Redwood Inference
Attachment: (none)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <pri.legal@brightline.ai>, Sam Patel <sam@brightline.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T08:17:00-08:00
Subject: BrightLine redlines — initial pass (MSA + Order Form)

Priya / Sam —

Attaching Redwood’s initial redline for the MSA and a revised order form (BrightLine_MSA_redline_20261130.docx). Key items where we’ve proposed changes:

- Section 6 (Indemnity): we kept BrightLine’s requested carveout for third‑party model providers but added a requirement for documented vendor assurance (p.3 comment).
- Section 12 (Data residency): your note requested updating to EU region conditional language; we converted that into an opt‑in Exhibit and left the core MSA unchanged.
- SLA Exhibit: clarified scheduled maintenance windows vs. dedicated capacity windows. Ops flagged that capacity guarantees during monthly batch windows will require a 14‑day lead time for reserved nodes.

Open asks for your side:
- Can BrightLine legal confirm the acceptable wording for the vendor assurance? We can accept an alternate clause if it’s functionally equivalent.
- Procurement: do you require a PO number on signature or can we go straight to DocuSign?

Timelines: we can provide a final counternote Dec 2 if we receive vendor language and procurement preference today.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachment: BrightLine_MSA_redline_20261130.docx (docx)
From: Priya Rao <pri.legal@brightline.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam@brightline.ai>, BrightLine Procurement <procurement@brightline.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T12:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: BrightLine redlines — initial pass (MSA + Order Form)

Marissa —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. A few quick responses:

- Vendor assurance: BrightLine is happy to provide a standard SOC2 summary + flowdown requirement; proposed language attached as ChangeLog-terms.md. If Redwood’s suggested phrasing maps to that same obligation, we can accept.
- PO vs DocuSign: Procurement prefers DocuSign with PO referenced in the Order Form. We can provide a PO post countersign if that’s absolutely required, but our goal is to use DocuSign for execution.

We reviewed the maintenance lead time note. Given the business impact, would Redwood consider a 7‑day lead time for scheduled monthly batch reservations if BrightLine ingests committed uplift pricing? If you can accept 7 days (with an exception carveout for larger multi‑week batch jobs requiring 14 days), that would speed our internal provisioning.

Priya Rao
Senior Counsel, BrightLine AI
Attachment: ChangeLog-terms.md (md)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <pri.legal@brightline.ai>, Sam Patel <sam@brightline.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T16:43:00-08:00
Subject: Re: BrightLine redlines — operations and sign path

Team —

Quick ops update and execution path:

- Reserved capacity lead time: we can make the monthly batch reservation process a standard 7‑day lead for single‑batch reservations under the 2.5x uplift profile. Anything that spans >72 hours of continuous dedicated capacity remains in the 14‑day bucket and requires a separate SOW (ops + pricing).
- Pricing: Hannah and I confirmed the uplift run rate; updated commercial table is embedded in OrderForm_Q4_v3.xlsx. We’ll push a clean copy to Drive and attach to DocuSign.
- Execution: Marissa, once legal confirms the vendor assurance wording is acceptable, we’re set to send for signature via DocuSign. Procurement — please confirm whether you want the PO referenced before we send (per Priya, PO can be referenced after signature).

If all good, Hannah will initiate DocuSign tomorrow morning so we can hit BrightLine’s mid‑December target.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Head of Customer Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachment: (commercial table inserted into OrderForm_Q4_v3.xlsx)
